title: The FAQ That Became a Product
short_teaser: Repeated customer questions can reveal a need for a guide, template, workshop, or service.
story: Repeated customer questions can reveal a need for a guide, template, workshop, or service. Questions are market evidence when patterns are recorded. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust through the decisions beneath the visible offer. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Questions are market evidence when patterns are recorded. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust through the decisions beneath the visible offer.
